[모멘텀 지표]

· 현 구간 진단 (축적구간) + 진입 조건 미충족, 관망 유지
analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current Price ($291.10) vs SMA5/20/50 ($294.20/$298.11/$296.75): Below short/mid-term trends, indicating a weak position.
· Position vs SMA100/200 ($290.70/$272.59): Above long-term trends, confirming a strong support base.
· 52-week Position (81.5%) + Current price range near historical highs.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI Trajectory (38.0 → 40.5) + Entering oversold exit zone, initial upward momentum confirmed.
· MACD Histogram Trajectory (-1.2526 → -0.8253) + Improvement diagnosed, weakening bearish reversal signal.
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (Lower $289.97 / Middle $298.11) + Approaching lower band, band width narrowed to 5.46%.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($290.68) + Basis (based on 20-day low).
· Swing Resistance ($292.88) + Potential for short-term bounce upon breakout.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Higher Low unconfirmed, sideways range continues).
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.65x) + Reduced confidence in the move.
· Current Stage Diagnosis (Accumulation) + Entry conditions not met, maintaining wait-and-see.
